# Sunveil Network & Sunveil Connect

> Zero-Portforwarding Minecraft Realm Tunnels, Native Mod Distribution, and Enterprise-Grade Multiplayer Networking.

## Overview
Sunveil Connect is a high-performance desktop launcher and networking bridge for Minecraft servers. It eliminates the need for manual port-forwarding, dynamic DNS, or third-party VPN software by providing secure, encrypted multiplexed TCP relays directly from client to server.

## Components
- **Sunveil Bridge**: Server-side plugin/mod for Paper, Spigot, Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge (Minecraft 1.20 - 1.21.x).
- **Sunveil Master API & Relay**: Fastify & WebSocket-based zero-copy TCP packet router with DDOS rate-limiting and Slowloris protection.
- **Sunveil Connect Desktop**: Qt6 / C++ native launcher for seamless 1-click modpack synchronization and multiplayer joining.

## Documentation & Endpoints
- Homepage: https://realms.sunveil.net/
- GitHub Client: https://github.com/svl-network/svl-connect
- GitHub Bridge: https://github.com/svl-network/svl-bridge
- GitHub Master API: https://github.com/svl-network/svl-master-api
